ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. For each section, add text in the special instructions field HERE. Then, enter a paragraph break and enter the following text: Disregard the assessment notations listed above. The graduate tuition rate for this section is $309 per credit hour; the undergrad tuition rate is $277 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee.
